scope: Polymarket BTC 5-minute up/down CLOB markets, series 10684
market_fee_schedule_source: Gamma per-market feesEnabled and feeSchedule fields, keyed by condition_id; https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets?condition_ids=<condition_id>&closed=true&limit=100; the 79,680-market scan is summarized in reports/btc_fee_history_20261010/gamma_fee_regime_market_counts.csv
market_fee_schedule_selection: Use the selected market's own Gamma metadata; market identity, not market-creation time or the order/entry timestamp, selects the fee schedule. Match/entry time selects the exchange collection unit. Do not select a fee schedule from last_trade_price.fee_rate_bps.

market_fee_regimes_observed.notes: All 11,431 confirmed market records from 2025-12-18T04:25Z through 2026-01-26T23:20Z had feesEnabled=false. The saved market calendar contains no markets from 2026-01-26T23:25Z through 2026-02-12T00:30Z. The first enabled BTC 5m market is 2026-02-12T00:35Z, so activation within that no-market gap cannot affect a traded market and is not assigned a fabricated boundary.
Market fee type label changed while rate and exponent remained the same; feeType is not treated as a separate economic regime.
All 50,184 T-59 opportunity markets carry this schedule; the full Gamma capture includes all 79,680 confirmed market records in the saved calendar.

fee_calculation.source: https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees and official py-clob-client-v2 fee calculation

cash_collateral.rounding: round half up to 0.00001 per modeled order

outcome_shares.rounding: floor to 6 decimals per aggregate price level in the saved ladder
outcome_shares.notes: Legacy CTF contract uses per-order feeRateBps as a maximum bound and the fee module refunds excess; archive feeRateBps is therefore not the actual operator fee. Historical per-match operator fee amounts and maker-fill decomposition are absent. The replay converts the documented rate/exponent fee amount to shares as a transparent estimate; it is not labeled as a confirmed V1 fee ledger.

execution_collection_regimes.decision_time: match/entry time; market identity selects the fee schedule
match/entry time; new entries excluded in this approximate window
match time in V2; market identity selects the fee schedule

rebates.reason: The modeled orders are takers and the market fee schedules are takerOnly. Gamma rebateRate metadata is not evidence of a rebate earned by these taker orders.

archive_field_audit.known_zero_values: explicit payload zero (the archive converter preserves missing as null); post-migration feeRateBps meaning is unverified and is not evidence of fee-free trading
archive_field_audit.known_1000_values: legacy order maximum/cap in bps; not actual fee amount

known_uncertainties: The public upgrade announcement gives an approximate one-hour window; exact cutover second is not independently confirmed.
No per-match legacy fee amounts or maker-fill decomposition are present in the saved T-59 snapshots.

For the saved T-59 history from 2026-04-15 17:05 UTC through 2026-10-06 23:55 UTC, Gamma feeSchedule was captured on 2026-10-10; original market-creation or match-time feeSchedule values are absent, so historical rate/exponent immutability is unresolved.
The exact V1-to-V2 cutover second within approximately 2026-04-28 11:00-12:00 UTC is unresolved; the replay excludes entries in that window.
The saved ladders aggregate depth by price and do not preserve maker order identities; exact simulated cash-fee rounding/minimum behavior per historical match cannot be reconstructed.
Historical Gamma metadata is captured now from each market record; the archive did not preserve the feeSchedule fields at original market creation.

The official maker-rebate page and exchange-upgrade notice describe buy-side fee collection differently; no maker rebate is credited, and the post-upgrade collateral rule follows the upgrade notice plus current fee documentation.
